local_changes: src/patch.c: save an existing -o output before truncation when -b is specified.
Select POSIX semantics by default in the private provider, including Index fallback and controlling-terminal reads.
Route progress, rejects and reverse prompts to stderr; retain the filename prompt on stdout.
Initialize the locale and use LC_MESSAGES yesexpr for reverse confirmations.
Keep anonymous per-input intermediate versions for repeated and interleaved -o patches, including ed scripts.
